classification.difficultyReason: Identify boundary equations, interpret strict or inclusive boundaries and select the shaded side.

inlines.text: State the inequalities which define each

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with a dotted vertical boundary and the region to its right shaded.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-3..5 and y=-4..4; boundary x=3; shaded region x>3.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible; the written inequality is answer-only.

answer.worked: The boundary is $x=3$. The shaded region is to its right, and the dotted boundary is excluded: $x>3$.

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with a solid horizontal boundary and the region below it shaded.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-5..5 and y=-3..5; boundary y=4; shaded region y<=4.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible; the written inequality is answer-only.

answer.worked: The boundary is $y=4$. The shaded region is below it, and the solid boundary is included: $y\leq4$.

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with a dotted rising boundary and its lower/right half-plane shaded.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-4..3 and y=-4..4; boundary y=2x+1 passes through (0,1) and (1,3); shaded region y<2x+1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible; the written inequality is answer-only.

answer.worked: The line passes through $(0,1)$ and $(1,3)$, so its gradient is $2$ and its equation is $y=2x+1$. The shaded region is below the dotted line: $y<2x+1$.

spec.description: Unit coordinate grid with a solid rising boundary and its upper/left half-plane shaded.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=-4..3 and y=-5..4; boundary y=3x-2 passes through (0,-2), (1,1) and (2,4); shaded region y>=3x-2.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible; the written inequality is answer-only.

answer.worked: The line passes through $(0,-2)$ and $(1,1)$, so its gradient is $3$ and its equation is $y=3x-2$. The shaded region is above the solid line: $y\geq3x-2$.
